limits: Approval and proof apply to this exact source and private ROM fingerprint. Final production allocation and independent-core validation remain root-owned.
Source-normalized widths, two shortened action silhouettes and authored placements differ as recorded; original lowest body pixels, six flecks and all native cell origins remain fixed.
Only seven phases in six locations were executed after reversible diagnostics with development party resources. This is not full campaign traversal or normal-level balance validation.
Peaceful inn35 and market39 load enemy13/gfx86 instead of Hench75. Their success is unrelated-owner/branch evidence; peaceful square31 separately proves visible Hench75.
Zero delay was observed in isolated AA30 field tests and six battle layer samples. This does not claim every gameplay transition has identical display latency.
Map, dialogue and party overlap can obscure native pixels in real scenes. Exact full cells/palettes and unobstructed final pixels are separately proved in all74 isolated poses.
Source scene unions combine verified conditional loads. They are conservative resource inventories, not proof of every simultaneous resident set.
